sentence: This project studies why one supercell storm produces a tornado while another does not, using existing numerical simulations.
This project studies how the generating mechanisms of extreme precipitation are changing and builds statistical curves for infrastructure design.
This project tests whether the order of human impacts on tropical reefs changes how well short turf algae communities resist and recover from disturbance.
This project uses an isotopic water analyzer to study where ground and surface waters come from and how climate changes water cycles.
This project builds an image data sharing ecosystem so researchers can share plant phenotyping images.
This project develops methods that make magnetic resonance signals from nitrogen stronger, to sense low oxygen found in aggressive cancers.
This project uses guided ion beam tandem mass spectrometry to measure energies of reactions of metal ions and protonated peptides.
This project gets extrusion-based 3D printing equipment, a rheometer, and an optical tensiometer to fabricate complex 3D structures and characterize material properties.
This project studies how Sonoran pronghorn and their gut bacterial, viral, and parasite communities respond to translocation to new habitats.
This project develops algorithms that detect adversarial artificial intelligence hidden in radio-control applications for cellular networks.
This project designs ways for federated learning on mobile devices to use less energy and network traffic while keeping data private.
This project acquires a super-resolution fluorescence lifetime confocal microscope to explore cellular and molecular processes in real time.
This project uses snake robots to collect data inside collapsed buildings and analyzes the mechanics of pancake collapses.
This project builds mathematical theory that explains when score-based generative models generalize beyond their training data.
This project studies how urbanization affects freshwater ecosystems and the health of urban rivers.
This project studies entangled states and develops ways to manipulate and mitigate errors in quantum bits.
This project studies how to control friction at nanoscale contacts of van der Waals heterostructures.
This project studies which genes are turned on in which cells of Arabidopsis thaliana embryos as seeds fill with starch, protein and fats.
